# Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes - June 26, 2025

> 日期: 2025-06-27 · 站点: en · 来源: https://overwatch.blizzard.com/en-us/news/patch-notes/live/2025/06

## Game Hotfix Update

This is a hotfix update targeting critical bugs. Replay codes from the June 24, 2025 patch are still available.

## Bug Fixes

### General

Fixed a bug with Wave Respawn from working correctly.

### Heroes

Ana Fixed a bug affecting Biotic Rifle's Quick Scope Animation.

### Stadium

D.Va Fixed a bug with Meka Punch. The power has been re-enabled Soldier: 76 Fixed a bug with Chaingun. The power has been re-enabled
